text.title: Churn Basics Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply `Churn Basics` end-to-end, then the churn analysis process checklist that step 3 expands into: define churn, measure current churn, analyze patterns and root causes, segment, set up the health score, dashboard and monitor. Each step has an input, an action, an output, and (where relevant) a decision gate.

step.name: scope-check
step.input: Trigger event + Applies-If / Skip-If from AGENTS.md.
step.action: Confirm every Applies-If holds and no Skip-If trigger fires. Document the result.
step.decision-gate: If NO-GO, STOP and route to a different methodology or escalate.

step.name: gather-inputs
step.action: Collect each prerequisite artefact + assign a named owner per row. Flag missing rows as blockers.
step.output: Prerequisites checklist signed off with owner per row.

step.name: draft-artefact
step.action: Fill the artefact skeleton; do not commit free-form output. Every conclusion carries an evidence link or `not_applicable: <reason>`.
step.decision-gate: If shape-rules in 02-output-contract violated, REJECT and rewrite.

step.name: review-and-evidence
step.action: Run the antipattern checklist against the draft; replace any handwave with evidence anchors.
step.decision-gate: If antipattern detected, repair before next step.

step.name: validate
step.action: Run the validator. Fix all VIOLATION lines.
step.decision-gate: If exit non-zero, return to draft.

step.name: commit-and-publish
step.action: Commit to the team's versioned space; publish a 2-line digest to the named cadence channel.

step.name: outcome-review
step.input: Committed artefact + outcome metrics over the next cadence cycle.
step.action: Measure whether the artefact changed behaviour (escape rate moved, conversion moved, churn moved, etc.). Record outcome.
step.output: Outcome-review note appended to the artefact.
step.decision-gate: If outcome shows no change over 2 cycles, propose deprecation.

section.title: Churn analysis process (expands step 3)
section.p: Ordered steps for establishing churn definitions, measuring baseline, segmenting causes, and setting up monitoring.

step.name: define-churn
step.action: Define customer churn with explicit cancel-date and grace-period rules. Define user churn separately if product has free tier (no login in X days). Choose measurement period (monthly is standard for SaaS). Separate voluntary from involuntary (failed payment) churn in schema. Document definitions in every dashboard description.
step.output: One written churn definition pinned on every dashboard (define-churn-once-in-writing rule).
step.decision-gate: Any dashboard without the definition text → block until pinned.

step.name: measure-current-churn
step.action: Calculate monthly customer churn rate and MRR churn rate. Calculate NRR (start + expansion - churn) / start. Report voluntary and involuntary churn separately. Calculate cohort-specific churn (signup quarter, plan, channel). Benchmark vs industry standards for your segment.
step.output: Baseline: customer churn, MRR churn, NRR, voluntary/involuntary split, cohort grid, benchmark position.
step.decision-gate: Any of the three metrics missing → REJECT (report-three-metrics-together rule).

step.name: analyze-patterns-and-root-causes
step.action: Identify when users churn: day 1, week 2, month 3, year-1 renewal. Compare churned vs retained user behavior (login frequency, feature usage). Survey every churner with 6 fixed-taxonomy reasons; free text as supplemental only. Interview high-value churners (top 20% by MRR). Analyze support ticket patterns in last 30 days before cancel. Categorize churn reasons; identify top 2-3 preventable categories.
step.output: Churn timing curve + reason taxonomy with preventable share.

step.name: segment
step.action: Segment churn by plan tier, signup channel, signup cohort quarter. Segment by usage level: power users, casual users, at-risk. Identify geography-specific churn patterns. Separate involuntary churn for dunning/recovery analysis.
step.output: Cohort × plan grid with segments > 2x aggregate flagged (segment-by-cohort-and-plan rule).

step.name: health-score-setup
step.input: Behavioral event data, last 90 days of churn.
step.action: Define 4-6 behavioral signals as health score inputs. Backtest thresholds against last 90 days of actual churn data. Set alert thresholds for CS outreach (score below 40). Recalibrate health score thresholds quarterly.
step.output: Backtested health score (model in `content/05-examples.xml`) with alert thresholds.
step.decision-gate: Thresholds not backtested → alerts stay off (backtest-health-score-90-days rule).

step.name: dashboard-and-monitor
step.action: Create monthly churn dashboard: customer churn, MRR churn, NRR, voluntary/involuntary split. Add cohort churn view segmented by plan, channel, quarter. Set up alerts for churn rate exceeding threshold. Generate weekly at-risk account list from health score. Track churn reasons over time to measure intervention impact.
step.output: Monthly dashboard + weekly at-risk list + reason trend.
